title: Sleek, Smart & Sustainable
bodyHtml:
Discover Oli

Designed for both aesthetics and performance, Oli’s in-wall cisterns and flush plates offer a seamless, architectural solution for both contemporary and classic style bathrooms.

Crafted in Portugal since 1954, Oli products are rigorously tested to deliver innovation, water efficiency, and effortlessly refined design.

Explore the Oli Range

Architectural Flush Plates

Select from an extensive range of designs, including premium PVD finishes to match your choice of tapware or accessories, as well as versatile ABS options, ensuring the perfect fit for your space.

Save Half a Litre with Every Flush

Oli’s in-wall cisterns are engineered with sustainability at their core, incorporating innovative water-saving technology to minimize environmental impact without compromising performance.

A unique delayed inlet valve reduces water consumption by approximately 0.5L with every flush, adding up to significant dollar savings as well as environmental benefits over time.

Uncompromising Quality & Testing

Every Oli in-wall cistern undergoes rigorous testing to ensure flawless performance and reliability.

Each unit is individually leakage and flush-tested after assembly, guaranteeing optimal functionality before it reaches your bathroom.

Peace of Mind Lifetime Spare Parts Availability

With a commitment to quality that extends beyond installation, we offer lifetime spare parts availability—ensuring that maintenance and repairs are hassle-free for the life of your product.

This dedication to ongoing support means you can invest in your bathroom with complete confidence, knowing that every component is backed by lasting peace of mind.

Save & Simplify with our Pan & Cistern Packages

To make specifying your bathroom project even easier, our thoughtfully curated cistern and pan packages streamline the selection process.

Our all-in-one solutions pair our high-performance Oli in-wall cisterns with any Studio Bagno pan style, ensuring seamless compatibility, effortless installation, and a perfectly coordinated design.

Explore our Complete Range of Flush Plates & Cisterns

Discover the perfect combination of flawless functionality and sleek design with Oli In-Wall Cisterns & Flush Plates.
